input_text: Real-time collaborative document editor (like Google Docs). Multiple users edit simultaneously. Must handle 100 concurrent editors per document. Conflict resolution via CRDT. Offline support with sync. Tech: TypeScript, WebSocket, Redis pub/sub.

Existing monolithic Rails app serving 2M users. Need to extract payment and notification services into separate services. Must maintain backward compatibility during 6-month migration. Current: Rails 7, PostgreSQL, Sidekiq. Team has no Kubernetes experience.
